column1: # The stock files that decide when the Play 6 hardware watchdog is taken over, per supported XGIMI firmware
# kheaders ... mik at early-boot, init.xgimi.gmpf.rc starts gmpf_main at post-fs, libporting.so holds its DrvWdt
# thread (30 tries once a second), mik.ko makes /dev/mik!wdt, init.mt5889.rc mounts what the modules read at fs.
# tools/play6/test_play6_early_mik.sh fails when a firmware of the registry or the installer has no rows here, and
# checks a stock vendor dump against them: a new XGIMI firmware is supported only after its boot path is compared.
# Sources: official FULL OTA V1.7.116 and the LumenDump of a G0058 on V1.8.127 (2026-11-12), equal file by file.
